normalization_derivation.connected_kernel: Pi^>_IJ(Q;t,s)=-i/2 sum_k Phi[-Q,k,Q-k]_Iab Phi[Q,-k,-Q+k]_Jcd W^>_k,ac W^>_(Q-k),bd; lesser uses its independent ordered reverse W. Full ordered internal-q sum routes BOTH Wick pairings to factor1/2. Retarded=theta(t-s)(greater-lesser), theta(0)=1. Mean only at Q0: -1/2 sum_k Phi[0,k,-k]:W_k(t,t).
normalization_derivation.coordinates: u_Ra=N^(-1/2) sum_q exp(+2pi i (q/mesh).R)u_qa, N64. Cartesian lattice gauge, no atomic exp(iq.tau), no mass scaling. q are exact integer tuples modulo mesh, with the actual original q/minus/Nyquist maps checked.
normalization_derivation.force: F_Q=-1/2 sum_k Phi[-Q,k,Q-k]u_k u_(Q-k). Right opposite vertex is evaluated independently at[Q,-k,-(Q-k)], not inferred by conjugation.
normalization_derivation.real_and_onsite: A translation-invariant per-cell scalar gives N from the common cell sum and N^(-3/2) from three canonical coordinate derivatives, hence Phi=N^(-1/2)*per-cell third for momentum-conserving q1+q2+q3=0 modulo mesh. Each real pair contributes product_l(delta_a_l,i-exp(iq_l.R)delta_a_l,j).
normalization_derivation.reciprocal: E_rec=4pi/(N*Omega) sum_K w(K) sum_Ri,Sj ZiZj exp(iK.(R+tau_i-S-tau_j)). Three canonical derivatives contribute N^(-3/2). The common-cell and relative-cell sums each contribute N; for every product subset A the latter imposes K=G-sum_(l in A)q_l. The resulting prefactor is4pi/(Omega*sqrt(N)); each tensor is(iK)^3 with independently retained subset signs. This is not a Gamma-only scalar extension.
